title: Investigate Gemini Live code=1011 mid-turn failures on 2.5 native-audio preview (reported ~80% since 2026-05-27)
description: Independent research while verifying model names (bd polyglot-pdf-lky) surfaced a Google AI Developers Forum report: 'gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025 returns code=1011 mid-turn at ~80% rate (started 2026-05-27)'. Our default MODEL_NATIVE is gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio (the stable alias) -- need to confirm whether (a) we're affected, (b) the stable alias resolves to the broken preview, and (c) whether to pin to a known-good model or fall back to cascade (USE_NATIVE_AUDIO=False) until Google fixes it. Now env-swappable (bd polyglot-pdf-9dq) so mitigation is a config change, no redeploy. Source: discuss.ai.google.dev/t/...167186 . NOT confirmed affecting us yet -- this is a watch/investigate item.
acceptance_criteria: Determined whether polyglot-pdf is affected by the 1011 mid-turn failures; if so, a mitigation (model pin or cascade fallback) is applied and documented.

title: copilot_watch.py crashes on Windows (cp1252) when Copilot comment contains emoji/non-latin1
description: scripts/copilot_watch.py prints Copilot's review detail via print(detail); on Windows the default stdout encoding is cp1252, so a Copilot comment containing an emoji (observed: U+1F4A1 light-bulb) raises UnicodeEncodeError and crashes the watcher AFTER it already classified the review as COMMENTS. The watcher then misreports ERROR. Fix: force UTF-8 stdout (e.g. sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')) or encode-safe the print in _emit(). Found exercising the new dev PR flow on PR #12.
acceptance_criteria: copilot_watch.py runs to a clean CLEAN/COMMENTS/ERROR/TIMEOUT verdict on Windows even when a review body contains emoji or other non-cp1252 characters; no UnicodeEncodeError.
close_reason: Merged-ready via PR #14 into dev. 39a: copilot_watch.py now reconfigures stdout/stderr to UTF-8 via _setup_utf8_stdio() (called from main(), not import-time) + _safe_print fallback so emoji in Copilot review bodies no longer crash the watcher on Windows cp1252; 2 regression tests with a cp1252-raising stdout stub. 252: removed dead commented gemini-2.5-pro normalizer block. Copilot round 1 (1 finding: 2.5-pro reintroduced in comment) + fresh-eyes (6 findings: fake-green tests, import-time stdout mutation, unguarded fallback, history-note comment) all addressed; round 2 CLEAN (work_finished, no findings). Suite 137 passed.
